data.name: ImprovedDebugConsole
data.shortDescription: A mod to improve the vanilla debug console
data.description:
Improved Debug Console takes the vanilla Sons of the Forest command console and adds much needed improvements, making it more accessible for everyone.


### Key Features:


- **Smart Auto-Complete:** Instantly suggests item names, characters, weather types, prefabs, and world events as you type.


- **In-Game Descriptions:** See exactly what every command does and what arguments it requires directly inside the console UI.


- **Universal Decimal Support:** Automatically handles both periods (0.5) and commas (0,5) for number inputs, preventing errors for international players.


### For developers:
If you want to register your own commands onto the system you can get more information here: https://github.com/laserman120/ImprovedDebugConsole-External-Command-Examples


### Warning!
Debug commands were originally made to debug the game. Some commands can do irreversable damage to your save. Use them with caution.
